title: What’s Real? AI
description: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn How Here
Artificial Intelligence is everywhere – from classrooms to boardrooms – and it’s changing the way humans behave. But is AI really as powerful as we think?

In this Soul Feast of The Gary Zukav Deepcast, Gary explores the deeper truth: AI can analyze, replicate, and accelerate behavior, but it cannot evolve the soul. Spiritual evolution is not created from machines. It is created by the concious choices we make between love and fear.

Gary unpacks the difference between external power – the drive to manipulate and control – and authentic power, which is born when our personality aligns with our soul. While AI can amplify old patterns, only human beings can create authentic power. The question is not whether AI will shape us, but how we will choose love or fear with it.

True transformation isn’t about technology; it’s about you. By making conscious choices of love, patience, gratitude, and reverence for life over fear, anger, and control, you contribute to the evolution of humanity – a creation only you can make.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:
(00:00) — A New Consciousness Emerging: Why humanity is shifting from an old, five-sensory world to a new multisensory consciousness.
(01:12) — AI and Human Behavior: How AI shapes behavior—making what we already do faster and more effective—but cannot touch evolution.
(07:09) — Old Power vs. Authentic Power: Why external power is based in fear and control, and why creating authentic power is humanity’s necessity.
(11:56) — The Soul’s Intentions: Harmony, cooperation, sharing, and reverence for life—and how aligning with these evolves the soul.
(14:32) — AI and Human Evolution: Why AI is only pattern recognition, and why authentic power—not machines—drives true human growth.
(17:00) — The Real Work Ahead: Why spiritual growth, not technological progress, determines whether humanity evolves or repeats old patterns.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: This week, take out your Soul Notebook and write down what resonated most with you from this episode. Reflect on how often you’ve applied that insight in your own life and notice the results it produced. Just like AI processes data, you’re “training” yourself – only your data is love, fear, and the choices you make. At the end of the week, look at the different consequences and ask yourself: Which future am I choosing?
